split: original order: first 60% train, next 10% calibration, next 10% validation, last 20% final test
cv: 3 expanding folds on training only; gap=100 rows (not days)
selection_rule: Exclude S1. Among non-dummy candidates within 0.02 AP of the best S2-S4 candidate, prefer fewer features, then higher AP, then shorter fit time.
calibration: Fit sigmoid on calibration block; retain only if validation Brier improves and slope is positive
threshold: maximize validation F1 over 0.05..0.80 in steps of 0.01; ties prefer the higher threshold
budget_metric: precision and lift among highest-scoring 20%; illustrative capacity, not a client contract
fallback: abstain for unseen categories or numeric values outside training min/max, or probability within 0.03 of threshold
local_gate: final AP > test prevalence; ROC-AUC >=0.60; lift@20 >=1.2; local model p95 <500ms
production_gate: human approval, legal contact eligibility, recent representative data, subgroup review and external deployment checks additionally required
test_policy: one final evaluation; global source counts already inspected and disclosed
deduplication: preserve raw rows; purge exact training-feature duplicates from subsequent evaluation blocks, without using outcome
